title: hitsPerPageSelector default value in v2
body:
Hi,

No more hitsPerPage in hits since v2.

How do we set a default value for `hitsPerPageSelector` Widget in instantsearch v2?

Thanks

comments.body: Just checked and I confirm that you can’t preselect a value, but I think this also wasn’t possible in v1 from reading the docs. We should probably add this option.

The solution is this:

```
instantsearch({searchParameters: {hitsPerPage: 3}})
```

So that no matter if you use our widgets you can always set it at the top level.
